ProgramUnit.Name: CTRL_BLK_2_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ctrl_blk_2_date IS
-- Added time zone changes to the "call_date" and "sched_date" columns in the below query.
-- Changes made by Kishore on 01/24/2012. IM 6307
cursor c1 is
select distinct trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, call_date)) -- Added by Kishore on 01/24/2012. IM 6307
from donor_lists where 
called_user = :user_menu.called_user 
and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, call_date)) between :ctrl_blk_1.from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.to_date
union
select distinct trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sched_date)) -- Added by Kishore on 01/24/2012. IM 6307
from donor_lists where 
sched_user = :user_menu.called_user 
and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sched_date)) between :ctrl_blk_1.from_date and :ctrl_blk_1.to_date;

BEGIN
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record;
 open c1;
 loop
 fetch c1 into :ctrl_blk_2.call_date;
 exit when C1%NOTFOUND ;
 :ctrl_blk_2.call_day := :ctrl_blk_2.call_date ;
 ctrl_blk_2_values;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 first_record;
 :GLOBAL.BLK2_flag := 'Y';
 go_block('user_menu');
END;

 END IF;

ProgramUnit.Name: CTRL_BLK_2_VALUES_SINGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CTRL_BLK_2_VALUES_SINGLE IS
sch_min NUMBER;
sch_max NUMBER;
CBK_DIFF NUMBER;
cbk_min NUMBER;
cbk_max NUMBER;
nct_min NUMBER;
avg_diff NUMBER;
BEGIN
/********* Avrage Hours*******************/
-- Added time zone changes to the "call_date" column and "sysdate" in the below query.
-- Changes made by Kishore on 01/24/2012. IM 6307
begin
 select substr(attrib_value1,1,4), substr(attrib_value1,6),substr(attrib_value2,1,4), 
 substr(attrib_value2,6), to_char(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate),'HH24MI')
 into cbk_min, cbk_max, sch_min, sch_max, nct_min
 from employee_attributes
 where staff_no = :donor_lists_single_date.called_user
 and attrib_code = to_char(:donor_lists_single_date.call_date, 'DY');
exception when no_data_found then
 cbk_min := 0;
 cbk_max := 0;
 sch_min := 0;
 sch_max := 0;
 nct_min := 0;
end;

 IF nvl(sch_max,0) != 0 THEN
 IF nvl(nct_min,0) < nvl(cbk_max,0) 
 and nvl(nct_min,0) > nvl(cbk_min,0) 
 THEN
 cbk_diff := nct_min-cbk_min;
 ELSIF nvl(nct_min,0) > nvl(cbk_max,0) 
 and nvl(nct_min,0) < nvl(sch_min,0) 
 THEN
 cbk_diff := cbk_max-cbk_min;
 ELSIF nvl(nct_min,0) > nvl(sch_min,0) 
 and nvl(nct_min,0) < nvl(sch_max,0) 
 THEN
 cbk_diff := (nct_min-sch_min)+(cbk_max-cbk_min);
 ELSE
 cbk_diff := (sch_max-sch_min)+(cbk_max-cbk_min);
 END IF;
 ELSIF nvl(sch_max,0) = 0 THEN
 IF nvl(nct_min,0) < nvl(cbk_max,0) 
 and nvl(nct_min,0) > nvl(cbk_min,0) 
 THEN
 cbk_diff := nct_min-cbk_min;
 ELSE
 cbk_diff := cbk_max-cbk_min;
 END IF;
 END IF;
IF cbk_diff > 0 THEN
 IF length(cbk_diff) > 3 THEN
 cbk_diff := substr(cbk_diff,1,2)||'.'||substr(cbk_diff,3);
 ELSE
 cbk_diff := substr(cbk_diff,1,1)||'.'||substr(cbk_diff,2);
 END IF;
ELSE
 cbk_diff := 8.00;
END IF;

/****** CALL BACK*******/
-- Added time zone changes to the "call_date" column in the below query.
-- Changes made by Kishore on 01/24/2012. IM 6307
begin
 select count(*) 
 into :donor_lists_single_date.clbck
 from donor_lists
 where called_user = :donor_lists_single_date.called_user
 and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, call_date)) = :donor_lists_single_date.call_date
 and call_code = 'CLBCK'
 group by called_user;
exception when no_data_found then
 :donor_lists_single_date.clbck := 0;
end;

IF cbk_diff > 0 THEN
 :donor_lists_single_date.cb_ah := 
 round(:donor_lists_single_date.clbck / cbk_DIFF ,2);
ELSE
 :donor_lists_single_date.cb_ah := 0;
END IF;


/****** SCHEDULE*******/
-- Added time zone changes to the "sched_date" column in the below query.
-- Changes made by Kishore on 01/24/2012. IM 6307
begin
 select count(*) 
 into :donor_lists_single_date.schld
 from donor_lists
 where sched_user = :donor_lists_single_date.called_user
 and trunc(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sched_date)) = :donor_lists_single_date.call_date
 and call_code = 'SCHLD'
 group by sched_user;
exception when no_data_found then
 :donor_lists_single_date.schld := 0;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_format varchar2(100); 
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then
 show_error('12019');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026, 50025)
 then -- 50025 added by MG on 02/11
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then 
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
message('muk 2');
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
